name: ActivEX Limited
summary: ActivEX Limited engages in the acquisition, identification, and delineation of mineral resource projects. The company focuses on the exploration of gold, copper, and potash mineralization. It holds interests in 1 granted mining lease located in Western Australia; and 23 granted exploration permits for minerals covering an area of approximately 1,536 square kilometers located in Northern Queensland. ActivEX Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
